items.body_ko: 외부 메모리는 LLM 에이전트가 과거 작업의 궤적을 새로운 작업을 위한 간결한 교훈으로 추출하여 경험으로부터 개선할 수 있도록 합니다. 그러나 메모리는 메모리 유발 저하로 이어질 수도 있습니다. 이는 에이전트가 메모리 없이는 해결할 수 있는 작업을 실패하는 경우인데, 종종 잘못된 교훈을 따르거나 유효한 교훈을 잘못 적용하거나 오독하기 때문입니다. 이는 교훈이 작업 성공 또는 실패로만 레이블링된 궤적에서 추론되지만, 일반적으로 그 교훈이 파생된 궤적 없이 제공되어 에이전트가 이를 확인할 방법이 없기 때문입니다. 이를 해결하기 위해 우리는 WikiTrace를 소개합니다. 이는 에이전트가 각 교훈을 원래 궤적과 대조하여 확인할 수 있도록 설계된 증거 연결 메모리 시스템입니다. 특히, 궤적이 종종 오류가 있는 교훈을 포착하는 데 필요한 증거를 여전히 포함하고 있다는 발견에 동기 부여를 받아, WikiTrace는 각 교훈을 간결한 통찰력으로 저장하고, 그 궤적이 왜 성공하거나 실패했는지에 대한 요약과 원본 궤적 자체에 연결합니다. 그런 다음, 새로운 작업에서 에이전트는 모든 통찰력에서 시작하며, 어떤 통찰력이 행동하는 데 필요한 세부 정보가 부족하거나, 다른 통찰력과 충돌하거나, 실패한 작업에서 온 경우, 터미널 도구를 사용하여 링크를 따라 내려가 누락된 세부 정보를 채우거나 행동하기 전에 통찰력을 수정합니다. 우리는 5가지 에이전트 벤치마크에서 WikiTrace를 검증했으며, 이는 기존 메모리 접근 방식과 동일한 통찰력만 주어진 기준선보다 지속적으로 우수한 성능을 보이며 메모리 유발 저하도 줄임을 보여줍니다. 우리 코드는 https://github.com/yukyeongleee/wikitrace에서 확인할 수 있습니다.
items.title_ko: 기억만 믿지 마라: 증거 연결 기억으로 LLM 에이전트의 기억 유발 성능 저하 감소
items.summary_ko: LLM 에이전트의 외부 기억 사용 시 발생하는 '기억 유발 성능 저하' 문제를 해결하기 위해 '증거 연결 기억(Evidence-Linked Memory)'을 제안합니다. 이는 에이전트가 잘못된 교훈을 따르거나 유효한 교훈을 오용하는 것을 방지하여 기억의 신뢰성을 높입니다.
items.why_ko: LLM 에이전트의 기억 기반 학습 시스템을 개선하여, 장기적인 임무 수행에서 에이전트의 안정성과 효율성을 크게 향상시킬 수 있는 핵심 기술입니다.

items.title: MammothDP: Private Boosted Decision Trees Ready for Trusted Hardware and Leakage-free Hyperparameters
items.body: Data spaces like the European Health Data Space (EHDS) require the protection of sensitive data in studies during the data's processing and the study's release alike. In this work, we investigate how to implement this mandate using established trusted execution environments (TEEs) and timing side-channel hardening to protect the processing even under a compromised server, and the state-of-the-art differential privacy (DP) notion to protect the release of studies on tabular data. This combined setup could seem to complete the picture, but in fact raises unexpected security challenges that we mitigate by introducing MammothDP: a significant milestone towards a holistic machine learning system based on the recent gradient boosted decision tree learner S-BDT that is provably DP if used within a privacy filter, timing side-channel hardened, and deployed on a TEE. To achieve a strong privacy-utility tradeoff, we introduce two novel components: an early stopping criterion that adaptively selects the number of trees without any privacy overhead, and an improved rollback protection that is no longer vulnerable under timing side-channel attacks.
items.title_ko: MammothDP: 신뢰할 수 있는 하드웨어 및 누출 없는 하이퍼파라미터를 위한 비공개 부스팅 결정 트리
items.summary_ko: MammothDP는 민감한 데이터 연구의 개인 정보 보호를 위해 신뢰할 수 있는 실행 환경(TEE)과 차등 프라이버시(DP)를 결합한 부스팅 결정 트리 구현입니다. 이는 특히 유럽 건강 데이터 공간(EHDS)과 같은 환경에서 데이터 처리 및 연구 결과 공개 시 데이터를 보호하는 방법을 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: 민감한 데이터를 다루는 AI 모델 개발에서 개인 정보 보호와 보안을 강화하는 데 중요한 솔루션을 제공하며, 의료 및 금융 분야 AI 개발자에게 필수적인 고려 사항입니다.

items.title: PSL-RGHA: Parallel Split Learning with Reference Gradient Half-Space Alignment for Mitigating Gradient Divergence
items.body: The escalating complexity of deep neural networks hinders the deployment of federated learning (FL) on resource-constrained devices, especially for multimedia applications such as on-device image classification and speech recognition. Parallel split learning (PSL) has emerged as a promising solution by offloading a substantial portion of the computational workload to the server through layer-wise model partitioning, making it particularly suitable for resource-limited visual and speech intelligence scenarios. However, the absence of client-side aggregation renders PSL sus ceptible to severe training divergence and potential convergence failure under heterogeneous data distributions. To address this challenge, we propose PSL-RGHA, a gradient-aligned PSL framework that employs reference gradient half-space alignment mechanism to mitigate training divergence among client devices. PSL-RGHA comprises two novel components: reference gradient progressive construction (RGPC) and gradient half-space alignment (GHA). Specifically, RGPC evaluates the directional consistency of client gradients and progressively synthesizes a robust reference gradient via Weiszfeld updates, effectively approximating the global descent direction. Then, GHA constrains client gradients within the reference half-space defined by RGPC to mitigate gradient conflicts and rectify local updates. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our PSL-RGHA framework outperforms existing baselines in various settings.
items.title_ko: PSL-RGHA: 기울기 발산 완화를 위한 참조 기울기 반공간 정렬을 사용한 병렬 분할 학습
items.summary_ko: PSL-RGHA는 리소스 제약이 있는 장치에서 심층 신경망을 위한 병렬 분할 학습(PSL)의 기울기 발산 문제를 해결하기 위한 방법입니다. 이는 참조 기울기 반공간 정렬을 통해 서버로 오프로드되는 계산량의 상당 부분을 처리하면서도 안정적인 학습을 가능하게 합니다.
items.why_ko: 리소스 제약이 있는 환경(예: 모바일, 엣지 디바이스)에서 분산 머신러닝, 특히 연합 학습 및 분할 학습의 효율성과 안정성을 높이는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Multimodal Abstention That Preserves Acquired Correct Answers
items.body: Adding abstention to a task-adapted multimodal model can discard correct answers, including capabilities acquired during adaptation. We formulate abstention repair as maximizing correct abstention on unanswerable questions under a budget on newly lost correct answers. We propose ReFrain (Regression-Free Abstention), which combines a linear probe on first-token logits, threshold calibration on held-out image clusters, and a deterministic veto that replaces rejected outputs with the displayed "none of the above" option while preserving all other responses. "Regression-free" denotes zero loss on the calibration set at the zero-budget target. All abstention methods in our main comparison start from the same answering-SFT checkpoint; we separately track lost correct answers, repaired errors, and retained SFT gains. On Qwen2.5-VL-3B, ReFrain at zero budget retains all 57 SFT-gained answers with no losses and improves correct abstention by 7.30 percentage points. At a 0.5% calibration budget, it reaches 74.05% correct abstention with 8 losses and retains 55 gains; CLIP-UP EmbLoRA reaches 64.65% with 62 losses, 41 repairs, and 40 retained gains. The same probe at its default threshold loses 298 correct answers. With models and thresholds frozen, confirmation on 228 independent question clusters yields 66.05% correct abstention and no losses at the 0.5% point, exceeding EmbLoRA by 32.72 percentage points. Ordinary refusal SFT achieves higher correct abstention at greater regression cost. Code and reproduction materials: https://github.com/ModeLiberaL/ReFrain.
items.title_ko: 획득한 정답을 보존하는 멀티모달 기권
items.summary_ko: ReFrain(Regression-Free Abstention)은 멀티모달 모델에서 기권 기능을 추가할 때 발생하는 '정답 폐기' 문제를 해결합니다. 답변할 수 없는 질문에 대한 올바른 기권을 최대화하면서, 새로 손실되는 정답에 대한 예산을 설정하는 방식으로 기권 기능을 최적화합니다.
items.why_ko: 멀티모달 AI 모델의 신뢰성을 높이고, 불확실한 상황에서 '모른다'고 말하는 능력을 개선하여 AI 시스템의 안전성과 사용자 경험을 향상시킵니다.

items.title: MMDM: Measuring Massive Multitask Decision Making
items.body: System-1 Decision Models directly make structured probabilistic decisions over query-specified options given a state in a single forward pass, without autoregressively generating reasoning trajectories or textual responses. Recent evaluations cover diverse tasks but often rely on existing benchmarks, where prior exposure to test material can obscure generalization. Moreover, real-world decision making often involves long contexts, large option spaces, and complex logical dependencies, challenges that existing benchmarks do not adequately capture together. Thus, we introduce MMDM (Massive Multitask Decision Making), a benchmark of 5,448 high-quality questions across 16 task categories, combining newly constructed tasks with source-grounded recompositions and rewrites for single-select, multi-select, and soft-label decision making in fresh contexts. It covers realistic scenarios such as agent state tracking, tool and skill selection, preference judgments, and rubric scoring, with option spaces ranging from 2 to 1,024 and inputs extending to 64,817 tokens. With MMDM, we conduct a comprehensive quantitative evaluation of 28 decision models, showing that many perform well on common knowledge yet struggle with interdependent options, constrained decisions, and multi-select tasks. For example, Perplexity Decider-V1.2 reaches 78.75% Hard Single-select Accuracy on world knowledge, but only 53.95% on option logic and 47.95% on constraint planning, while the best Hard Multi-select Accuracy across all models is 36.81%. These results highlight joint reasoning, constraint-aware selection, and complete multi-select recovery as key priorities for decision model development, with MMDM providing a testbed for measuring this progress.
items.title_ko: MMDM: 대규모 멀티태스크 의사결정 측정
items.summary_ko: MMDM은 기존 벤치마크의 한계를 넘어, 긴 컨텍스트, 큰 옵션 공간, 복잡한 논리적 의존성을 포함하는 실제 의사결정 시나리오에서 System-1 의사결정 모델의 능력을 평가하는 새로운 벤치마크입니다.
items.why_ko: AI 모델의 실제 세계 의사결정 능력을 보다 정확하게 평가할 수 있는 표준을 제시하여, 복잡한 비즈니스 및 사회적 문제 해결에 기여하는 AI 시스템 개발을 촉진합니다.

items.title: LM-SimBench: A Unified Framework, Dataset, and Benchmark for Large Language Model Training Simulation
items.body: Evaluating candidate parallelization strategies through distributed training runs makes strategy selection prohibitively expensive at scale. Performance simulation offers a lower cost alternative, yet controlled comparisons among existing simulators remain difficult because they differ in the training stages they model and the workloads on which they are evaluated. We introduce LM-SimBench, a unified framework, profiling dataset, and benchmark for evaluating LLM training simulators. The framework decomposes simulation into functional stages from model compilation to schedule level aggregation, connecting execution representations and cost estimators to measurable evaluation targets. Following this framework, we profile 23 model settings from 10 dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLM families on an Ascend Neural Processing Unit (NPU) cluster. The resulting dataset contains 348 feasible configurations that jointly vary five parallelism dimensions and activation recomputation, with six views spanning configuration, rank, operator, event, and kernel granularity. Evaluations of representative training simulators demonstrate how LM-SimBench supports comparisons of prediction accuracy, assessment of configuration selection, and diagnosis of prediction errors. Matched GPU-NPU experiments validate the cross-platform applicability of the collection and evaluation protocol and demonstrate NPU-guided GPU configuration selection.
items.title_ko: LM-SimBench: 대규모 언어 모델 훈련 시뮬레이션을 위한 통합 프레임워크
items.summary_ko: LM-SimBench는 LLM 훈련 시뮬레이터 평가를 위한 통합 프레임워크, 프로파일링 데이터셋, 벤치마크입니다. 이는 분산 훈련 실행을 통한 병렬화 전략 평가의 비용 문제를 해결하기 위해 성능 시뮬레이션을 제공합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM 훈련의 병렬화 전략을 효율적으로 평가하고 최적화할 수 있는 도구를 제공하여, 대규모 LLM 개발 비용과 시간을 절감하는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Ninety-Six Ways to Measure a Scribe: Fragmented Evaluation of Ambient Scribes in Healthcare
items.body: Ambient artificial intelligence (AI) scribes have moved rapidly from experimental pilots to enterprise-wide deployment across health systems, promising reduced documentation burden and improved clinician experience. While research evaluating these tools has expanded quickly, there are no agreed-upon protocols or standardized metrics for assessing their performance, making it difficult to compare findings or cumulatively synthesize evidence across studies. Across 54 recent evaluation studies, we identify ten evaluation dimensions and 40 distinct metrics, operationalized in 96 different ways-35 of them (36%) used by only a single study. Assessment is dominated by documentation efficiency and time, measured in 44 of 54 studies. The other dimensions appear at broadly similar rates (16-24 studies each), and safety and clinical outcome least consistently of all. Ripple effects on the broader care system, such as impact on patients' care outcomes, redistribution of work, changes in billing and coding intensity, and downstream use of notes by other clinicians are rarely assessed. Moreover, the metrics used rely heavily on self-report and are fragmented and inconsistently operationalized, which limits comparability and hinders synthesis across studies. As an effort to support more rigorous and cumulative evaluation, in this paper we review the study designs, data sources, and metrics commonly used to evaluate ambient AI scribes in healthcare settings, discuss the limitations of current evaluation practice, and argue for a more holistic approach grounded in a standardized, multi-dimensional set of metrics.
items.title_ko: 스크라이브를 측정하는 96가지 방법: 의료 분야 주변 기록자의 단편적 평가
items.summary_ko: 의료 분야에서 AI 주변 기록자(ambient scribes)의 성능을 평가하는 데 있어 표준화된 프로토콜이나 지표가 부족하다는 점을 지적합니다. 54개의 최근 평가 연구를 분석하여 현재의 단편적인 평가 방식의 문제점을 논의합니다.
items.why_ko: 의료 AI 시스템, 특히 기록 보조 AI의 성능을 객관적으로 평가하고 비교할 수 있는 표준화된 방법을 모색하는 데 중요한 배경 지식을 제공합니다.

items.title: Compositional random forest
items.body: Compositional data have been analysed in the literature from three main points of view: directly on the simplex, in log-ratio coordinates, and as directional data on the unit sphere. In this paper, we construct a random forest framework for compositional responses that accommodates all three. Random forests are ensembles of decision trees, and the split criterion determines how each tree grows. We use the log-likelihood gain as the split criterion and consider distributions defined on the different spaces in which compositions can be represented. The Dirichlet likelihood has been studied in the literature, but its covariance is fixed by its mean up to a single scalar, and its maximum likelihood estimator has no closed form. To obtain more flexible criteria, we use two well-known transformations. First, the square-root transformation maps compositions onto the unit sphere, where existing directional distributions require numerical estimation. We introduce a tangent-normal (TN) distribution, which shares its parameters with the Kent distribution, and construct a split criterion whose gain is computed from additive sufficient statistics: the shape parameters are maximised out in closed form, up to an exponentially small truncation constant, so that no parameter is estimated iteratively. Second, the log-ratio transformation maps compositions to Euclidean space, where the multivariate logistic-normal distribution has a flexible covariance and a closed-form maximum log-likelihood, also based on additive sufficient statistics. Both criteria respond to a shift of the mean, measured relative to the covariance, and to a change in the covariance itself. In simulations, the most accurate forest depended on the covariance structure of the composition. The TN forest was the most accurate in two of the three designs.
items.title_ko: 구성적 랜덤 포레스트
items.summary_ko: 구성적 데이터(compositional data)를 처리하기 위한 랜덤 포레스트 프레임워크를 제시합니다. 이는 심플렉스, 로그-비율 좌표, 단위 구에서의 방향 데이터 등 세 가지 주요 관점을 수용하며, 로그-우도 이득을 분할 기준으로 사용합니다.
items.why_ko: 구성적 데이터 분석에 새로운 머신러닝 모델을 제공하여, 지질학, 금융, 사회 과학 등 비율 데이터가 중요한 분야의 AI 애플리케이션 개발에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Federated Learning for Cross-Regional Epidemic Forecasting with Asynchronous Outbreaks
items.body:
Objective: Epidemic outbreaks are often asynchronous across regions, yet collaborative forecasting is hampered by privacy laws and heterogeneous public health interventions. We developed and evaluated, as a proof of concept, a federated learning (FL) framework for cross-regional COVID-19 forecasting under asynchronous outbreaks among Guangdong, Macau, and Portugal, while maintaining data sovereignty.
Methods: Using daily case data from WHO and China CDC for the three regions, whose outbreaks were asynchronous and interventions heterogeneous, we trained Long Short-Term Memory networks via FL for short-term forecasting, benchmarked against localized and centralized training using Root Mean Square Error, Mean Absolute Error, and Symmetric Mean Absolute Percentage Error. All experiments used the Flower FL framework with consistent hyperparameters across sites. Publicly available, aggregated case-count data were used so that the centralized benchmark could be computed as a reference.
Results: The dataset comprised 1,233 daily observations (411 days) of new confirmed COVID-19 cases from November 24, 2021, to January 8, 2023. The earlier Omicron wave in Portugal supplied transmission dynamics that improved forecasts in the later-onset regions of Macau and Guangdong. The FL model achieved a normalized Root Mean Square Error of 0.028, an 88.3% improvement over the local model (0.240) and comparable to the centralized model, with network overhead mainly determined by model size and aggregation rounds.
Conclusion: FL achieved short-term forecasting accuracy close to centralized training while maintaining data residency, with acceptable overhead. Leveraging asynchronous outbreaks across regions may offer a practical path to privacy-preserving collaborative forecasting, though prospective validation is required.
items.title_ko: 비동기적 발병을 동반한 교차 지역 전염병 예측을 위한 연합 학습
items.summary_ko: 개인 정보 보호 규제와 이질적인 공중 보건 개입으로 인해 제한되는 교차 지역 전염병 예측을 위한 연합 학습(Federated Learning, FL) 프레임워크를 개발하고 평가했습니다. 광둥, 마카오, 포르투갈 간의 비동기적 COVID-19 발병 데이터를 사용했습니다.
items.why_ko: 개인 정보 보호를 유지하면서 분산된 데이터 소스를 활용하여 전염병을 예측하는 효과적인 방법을 제시하여, 공중 보건 및 연합 학습 분야에 중요한 기여를 합니다.

items.title: Achieving Robust Channel Estimation Neural Networks on Doppler effects by Designed Training Data
items.body: Channel estimation is crucial in wireless communication systems. Many existing works train and test their models using the same or similar channel. However, practical channels are infinitely diverse and time-variant while data-driven algorithms often degrade on new and previously unseen channels. This prohibits the practical implementation of neural networks for channel estimation, particularly in high speed scenarios characterized by rapidly channel profile changes and very high Doppler shifts. Online training can fine-tune models to adapt to new channels, but requires high computation resource and incurs significant latency for physical-layer devices. Moreover, online training cannot exhaustively cover all possible channels because there are infinitely many possible channels. Therefore, we investigate the ability of neural networks to generalize to wireless channels. This paper proposes design criteria to generate synthetic training data, which guaranty that the resulting networks perform robustly across wireless channels, especially for very high Doppler shifts and different Doppler spectra. It ensures that offline-trained neural networks require no prior information or online training to precisely estimate the new channels. To demonstrate general applicability, we use neural networks with different levels of complexity to show that the generalization achieved appears to be independent of architecture. From simulation results, neural networks achieve a certain performance across wireless channels with different unseen power delay profiles (PDP) and Doppler shifts.
items.title_ko: 설계된 훈련 데이터를 통해 도플러 효과에 강건한 채널 추정 신경망 달성
items.summary_ko: 무선 통신 시스템에서 채널 추정은 매우 중요하지만, 기존 데이터 기반 알고리즘은 새로운 채널에서 성능이 저하되는 문제가 있습니다. 이 논문은 도플러 효과에 강건한 채널 추정 신경망을 위해 설계된 훈련 데이터를 사용하는 방법을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 무선 통신 시스템의 채널 추정 정확도를 높여, 5G/6G 통신 및 자율 주행 차량과 같은 고속 환경에서 AI 기반 통신 기술의 신뢰성을 향상시킵니다.

items.title: Physics-Constrained Autoencoder for Interpretable Health Representation Learning in Turbofan Engines
items.body: Health Indices (HIs) summarize degradation from operational data and support diagnostic and prognostic tasks in Prognostics and Health Management (PHM). Their usefulness depends on capturing degradation and interpreting system condition. Autoencoders learn such representations from unlabelled monitoring data; however, when training is driven only by reconstruction, the physical meaning of latent variables remains undefined, limiting their interpretation and diagnostic value. This work proposes a physics-constrained autoencoder that embeds system knowledge as an inductive bias in the decoder architecture and as a learning bias in the loss function. The decoder contains differentiable physical equations that receive latent variables and operating conditions as inputs, structurally guiding each latent variable to represent a predefined physical quantity and enabling component-level analysis before aggregation into a system-level HI.The methodology is benchmarked on the N-CMAPSS dataset against alternative representations. Reconstruction reaches an $R^2$ of 0.9993 and an MAE of 0.0036, comparable to fully data-driven models. After operating-condition correction, the inferred physical quantities track degradation, and their aggregation produces an HI with a Spearman correlation of 0.9791 with the ground truth, an RMSE of 0.0286, and an MAE of 0.0233. The methodology is further evaluated using a single model trained across four datasets representing distinct degradation scenarios. This model preserves component-level signatures that distinguish compression-side from expansion-side degradation without diagnostic labels.Finally, the proposed framework enables degradation trends to be visualized on component maps, providing a health representation in a form familiar to engine operators and domain experts.
items.title_ko: 터보팬 엔진의 해석 가능한 건강 표현 학습을 위한 물리 기반 오토인코더
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 터보팬 엔진의 운전 데이터에서 성능 저하를 요약하고 시스템 상태를 해석할 수 있는 건강 지수(HI)를 학습하기 위해 물리 제약 오토인코더(Physics-Constrained Autoencoder)를 제안합니다. 재구성만을 목표로 하는 기존 오토인코더의 한계를 극복합니다.
items.why_ko: 산업 설비의 예측 및 건전성 관리(PHM) 분야에서 AI 모델의 해석 가능성을 높여, 장비 고장 진단 및 예측의 신뢰성과 유용성을 향상시킵니다.

items.title: Chain of Physics: Supporting Fault Diagnosis with Engineering-Inspired Large Language Model Reasoning
items.body: Fault diagnosis in complex systems requires linking observed changes in physical quantities to the failure mechanisms that produce them. Experienced engineers perform this task by combining sensor information with knowledge of system behavior and fault propagation. Large Language Models (LLMs) can support this process, but their diagnostic reasoning depends on the availability of asset-specific engineering knowledge and on how this knowledge is represented and used during inference. This work introduces Chain of Physics (CoP), an LLM-based fault-diagnosis framework built around a Constrained Knowledge Graph (CKG) generated automatically from asset-specific reference documentation. CoP addresses failure-sensor association from textual engineering knowledge. The CKG stores diagnostic chains connecting failure modes, changes in physical quantities, and monitoring sensors. During inference, semantically similar graph paths are retrieved for each question and used as both information and in-context examples for the reasoning process. Candidate failure modes are extracted from the question and analysed independently through dedicated LLM calls, which generate plausible failure-to-observation chains. A final decision module compares these chains with the available answer choices. CoP is evaluated on the FailureSensorIQ benchmark across four industrial asset classes and three LLMs. Compared with direct prompting and conventional Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), CoP improves diagnostic accuracy across all evaluated models, with gains ranging from 7.8 to 19.6 percentage points and from 11.7 to 18.2 percentage points, respectively. The results show that structured engineering knowledge can improve LLM-based diagnostic reasoning when graph retrieval is combined with in-context examples of fault propagation.
items.body_ko: 복잡한 시스템의 고장 진단은 물리량에서 관찰된 변화를 이를 야기하는 고장 메커니즘과 연결하는 것을 필요로 합니다. 숙련된 엔지니어는 센서 정보와 시스템 동작 및 고장 전파에 대한 지식을 결합하여 이 작업을 수행합니다. 대규모 언어 모델(LLM)은 이 과정을 지원할 수 있지만, 진단 추론은 자산별 엔지니어링 지식의 가용성과 이 지식이 추론 중에 어떻게 표현되고 사용되는지에 따라 달라집니다. 본 연구는 자산별 참조 문서로부터 자동으로 생성된 Constrained Knowledge Graph (CKG)를 중심으로 구축된 LLM 기반 고장 진단 프레임워크인 Chain of Physics (CoP)를 소개합니다. CoP는 텍스트 엔지니어링 지식에서 고장-센서 연관성을 다룹니다. CKG는 고장 모드, 물리량의 변화, 모니터링 센서를 연결하는 진단 체인을 저장합니다. 추론 중에 각 질문에 대해 의미적으로 유사한 그래프 경로가 검색되고, 이는 추론 과정에서 정보 및 상황 내(in-context) 예시로 사용됩니다. 후보 고장 모드는 질문에서 추출되어 전용 LLM 호출을 통해 독립적으로 분석되며, 이는 그럴듯한 고장-관찰 체인을 생성합니다. 최종 결정 모듈은 이러한 체인을 사용 가능한 답변 선택지와 비교합니다. CoP는 4가지 산업 자산 클래스와 3가지 LLM에 걸쳐 FailureSensorIQ 벤치마크에서 평가됩니다. 직접 프롬프트 방식 및 기존 Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)과 비교하여 CoP는 평가된 모든 모델에서 진단 정확도를 향상시키며, 각각 7.8에서 19.6%포인트, 11.7에서 18.2%포인트의 증가를 보입니다. 결과는 그래프 검색이 고장 전파의 상황 내 예시와 결합될 때 구조화된 엔지니어링 지식이 LLM 기반 진단 추론을 개선할 수 있음을 보여줍니다.
items.title_ko: Chain of Physics: 엔지니어링에서 영감을 받은 LLM 추론으로 고장 진단 지원
items.summary_ko: Chain of Physics는 LLM이 복잡한 시스템의 고장 진단을 지원하도록 하는 새로운 접근 방식입니다. 센서 정보와 시스템 동작 및 고장 전파 지식을 결합하여, 엔지니어링에서 영감을 받은 추론을 통해 물리량의 변화를 고장 메커니즘에 연결합니다.
items.why_ko: 산업 시스템의 고장 진단에 LLM을 효과적으로 활용하는 방법을 제시하여, 제조업 및 유지 보수 분야에서 AI 기반 문제 해결 능력을 크게 향상시킬 수 있습니다.

items.title: Recurrent Modular Structure in Spiking Neural Network Reinforcement Learning
items.body: Biological neural circuits are both modular and recurrent, with dense communities sparsely linked to one another. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) for reinforcement learning are usually feed-forward, and it is unclear how to obtain functional modules in a recurrent SNN or what they buy. In this work, we introduce a class of spiking networks, called Community Recurrent SNNs (CoRe SNNs): recurrent networks partitioned into communities with fixed roles. A controller community receives the stimulus, each action has its own community, and latent communities carry internal state. Spiking activity is then a walk between communities, and the action is the community the walk reaches. All learning is local and three-factor, and the recurrent communities are closer to cortical microcircuits than a feed-forward actor. We compare three regimes for obtaining the communities: dynamic modularity, in which a new learning rule we introduce, Map-STDP, encourages modular structure during learning; partial modularity, in which a stochastic block model (SBM) initialization enforces it partly; and full modularity, in which sealing enforces it fully. On CartPole, across three spiking neuron models, Map-STDP improves learning over the same network without it matches full modularity (sealed communities) on two of the three models, and makes the observed spike walk more compressible. Replacing the feed-forward actor of a TD-STDP actor-critic with recurrent action communities improves on the feed-forward network on CartPole and LunarLander, and matches it on Acrobot. How strongly to enforce modularity depends on the task: full modularity helps most on Acrobot, while on LunarLander the dynamic, partial and full regimes perform alike. Overall, these recurrent modular networks can match or even improve upon feed-forward approaches, with improvements in bio-plausibility and energy efficiency.
items.title_ko: 스파이킹 신경망 강화 학습에서의 순환 모듈형 구조
items.summary_ko: 스파이킹 신경망(SNN) 강화 학습에서 기능적 모듈을 얻는 방법과 그 이점에 대한 연구입니다. Community Recurrent SNN(CoRe SNN)이라는 새로운 종류의 스파이킹 네트워크를 도입하여, 고정된 역할을 가진 커뮤니티로 분할된 순환 네트워크를 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 뇌 영감 컴퓨팅(neuromorphic computing) 및 SNN 기반 강화 학습 분야에서 모델의 효율성과 복잡한 작업 수행 능력을 향상시키는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Lilo: A Multi-Agent Conversational Sandbox for Children's Digital Communication
items.body: Children's peer conflicts increasingly play out in group chats, where tone and timing are stripped away, and a hurtful message is easier to send than to say aloud. We present Lilo, a multi-agent conversational system that lets children practice such conversations, so they are better prepared when they encounter them in real digital communication. In Lilo, the child joins two AI-driven peers mid-argument, coached by a mentor character, also named Lilo, through a Stop-Think-Act traffic light. Through an exploratory study with 28 children (aged 9-11), we examine how children engage with Lilo's simulated peer conflict and the mentor's traffic-light interventions. The study included an intervention with Lilo, surveys before and after the intervention, and exit interviews. Participants reported significantly higher self-efficacy for coping with unpleasant messages after their interaction with Lilo. They felt safe experimenting, knowing nothing they wrote would be held against them.
items.title_ko: Lilo: 아동 디지털 소통을 위한 멀티 에이전트 대화형 샌드박스
items.summary_ko: Lilo는 아동들이 그룹 채팅에서 발생할 수 있는 갈등 상황을 연습할 수 있도록 돕는 멀티 에이전트 대화형 시스템입니다. AI 기반 또래 캐릭터와 멘토 캐릭터를 통해 '멈추고-생각하고-행동하기' 신호등 코칭을 제공합니다.
items.why_ko: 어린이의 디지털 소통 능력을 향상시키기 위한 AI 에이전트의 혁신적인 활용 사례를 보여주며, 교육 및 아동 심리 분야 AI 개발에 대한 새로운 가능성을 제시합니다.

items.title: A Cross-Scenario Survey and Analysis of Self-Evolving Multimodal Agents
items.body: Recent work shows that multimodal agents increasingly self-improve without recurring human annotation. However, each self-improvement mechanism is designed and evaluated within a single scenario, leaving its preconditions unverified under cross-scenario transfer. This survey investigates the structural source of asymmetric mechanism transfer across four scenarios: multimodal reasoning, multimodal generation, GUI and Web navigation, and embodied manipulation. We first formalize the self-evolving multimodal agent by four criteria and a differentia of self-reference, and adopt the three-stage self-evolving loop of experience generation, feedback acquisition, and update consolidation as our analytical framework to position the scenarios along ceilings on rollout count and feedback fidelity. Comparing self-evolving with fixed loops within each scenario separates the limitations that the scenario imposes from those inherent in the self-evolving design. We then recast each mechanism as a trade-off that raises a scarce factor by presupposing a task-structural resource, such as output equivalence or checkable outcomes, and judge it portable, conditional, blocked, or redundant across scenarios. We attribute the asymmetry to divergent combinations of scarce factors and resources across opposite transfer directions, and identify the matched-budget measurements that could overturn these still untested verdicts.
items.title_ko: 자체 진화 멀티모달 에이전트의 교차 시나리오 조사 및 분석
items.summary_ko: 이 설문조사는 멀티모달 추론, 멀티모달 생성, GUI 및 웹 탐색, 구체화된 조작의 네 가지 시나리오에서 자체 진화 메커니즘의 비대칭 전이의 구조적 원인을 조사합니다. 자체 진화 멀티모달 에이전트의 작동 방식과 한계를 분석합니다.
items.why_ko: 멀티모달 AI 에이전트의 자체 학습 및 개선 메커니즘을 심층적으로 이해하여, 다양한 실제 환경에서 강력하고 신뢰할 수 있는 AI 에이전트를 개발하는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Semantic Chains: From Reachable Facts to Justified Answers
items.body: How can the facts that justify an answer be found from a question and presented as a sequence of connected statements? This paper models a context as a graph of logical facts and takes as given which expressions represent each fact. A parent fact can express a relation among its subfacts, and a preserving edge allows the content of a subfact to be recovered within a full representation of its parent. Suppose a root fact justifies the full answer and a path of preserving edges leads from that root to a fact that designates an object shared by the question and the answer. Under the conditions of the model, a search starting from the objects in the question reaches the root and covers every fact in the selected expansion. The root then admits a text that forms a single link connecting the question to the full answer and justifying it. For chains with several links, the paper gives a complete enumeration of candidate orders within the stated class and specifies when the link texts jointly preserve the justification and support every transition.
items.title_ko: 의미론적 체인: 도달 가능한 사실에서 정당화된 답변까지
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 질문으로부터 답변을 정당화하는 사실들을 찾아 연결된 진술의 시퀀스로 제시하는 방법을 탐구합니다. 컨텍스트를 논리적 사실들의 그래프로 모델링하고, 보존 엣지를 통해 부사실의 내용을 부모 사실의 전체 표현 내에서 복구할 수 있도록 합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM의 추론 및 설명 능력을 향상시키는 데 기여하며, 복잡한 질문에 대한 논리적이고 정당화된 답변을 생성하는 AI 시스템 개발에 유용합니다.

items.title: Personalized Affective Perception via Continual Learning in Human-Agent Negotiation
items.body: Self-interested intelligent agents that negotiate with humans should interpret nonverbal expressions and adapt their behavior accordingly. However, generic facial-affect models degrade across individuals and contexts, creating a generalization gap. We introduce an affect-adaptive negotiation strategy that incorporates Continual Learning with Imagination for Facial Expression Recognition (CLIFER) to personalize valence-arousal perception in real time. Differential feedback converts changes in valence-arousal direction and intensity into adjustments of the agent's target utility. An asynchronous architecture updates CLIFER in the background during live interaction. In a counterbalanced within-subject study in which 66 participants negotiated with a humanoid robot, the CL-enabled agent achieved significantly higher individual utility and elicited higher participant concession rates than the FaceChannel baseline. The CL condition yielded significantly higher mean arousal estimates, alongside a broader output range. Participant utility and Nash distance did not change significantly between conditions. These outcomes support the practical value of coupling continual affective personalization with differential feedback for real-time negotiation.
items.title_ko: 인간-에이전트 협상에서 지속 학습을 통한 개인화된 정서 인식
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 인간과 협상하는 지능형 에이전트가 비언어적 표현을 해석하고 행동을 조정할 수 있도록, 안면 표정 인식(CLIFER)을 위한 상상 기반 지속 학습을 통합한 정서 적응 협상 전략을 도입합니다. 개인의 감정을 실시간으로 인식하고 적응할 수 있도록 합니다.
items.why_ko: 인간-AI 상호작용의 자연스러움과 효율성을 높이는 데 기여하며, 특히 협상이나 고객 서비스와 같은 감성 지능이 필요한 AI 에이전트 개발에 중요한 기술입니다.

items.title: SinkState: On-the-Fly SVD of Recurrent States for Efficient Hybrid LLM Serving
items.body: Hybrid models combine softmax attention with linear attention, which compresses history into fixed-size recurrent states to balance model quality and inference efficiency. However, linear attention has not pushed this compression to its limit: we find that the queries, keys, and values of linear layers concentrate in a stable, low-dimensional subspace, a phenomenon we call the linear attention sink, so each state is effectively low-rank, with a rank that varies across states. Yet existing serving systems keep these redundant states dense, reading and rewriting them in full at every decoding step, so their memory traffic grows with the batch size and dominates the decoding cost. Thus SinkState stores each recurrent state in an adaptive low-rank form throughout inference with buffered updates and a local SVD restricted to the top subspace. SinkState further consolidates the remaining components asynchronously on the CPU. On four hybrid models with Mamba-2 and Gated DeltaNet (GDN) layers, from 4B to 120B parameters, SinkState reduces the peak memory of recurrent states by up to 2.6x (1.9x on average) and speeds up decoding by up to 1.58x (1.25x on average) over Mamba-SSM and FLA, while maintaining accuracy.
items.title_ko: SinkState: 효율적인 하이브리드 LLM 서빙을 위한 순환 상태의 즉석 SVD
items.summary_ko: SinkState는 하이브리드 LLM 서빙의 효율성을 높이기 위해 선형 어텐션 레이어의 쿼리, 키, 값이 낮은 차원의 부분 공간에 집중되는 현상('선형 어텐션 싱크')을 활용합니다. 이를 통해 각 순환 상태가 효과적으로 낮은 랭크를 가지며, 즉석에서 SVD를 적용하여 효율적인 압축을 달성합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM 서빙의 메모리 사용량과 계산 비용을 줄여, 대규모 LLM을 더 효율적으로 배포하고 운영할 수 있도록 지원하는 핵심 기술입니다.

items.title: An AI Assistant for Automating Anti-Corruption Expertise of Draft Legislation Based on the TRACE Framework
items.body: We present an AI assistant for automating anti-corruption expertise of draft legislation based on the TRACE architecture, designed to screen bills for corruption risks: pinpoint provisions an expert would criticise and name the regulatory defect in each. The pipeline combines a deterministic parsing core, model-guided single-provision qualification, rule-based factor assignment, and external human oversight. To evaluate the assistant, we constructed an open benchmark from the published conclusions of Ukraine's National Agency on Corruption Prevention (NAZK), comprising 132 draft laws with 474 model-extracted findings. A system flag agrees with a finding when it targets a compatible provision and an LLM judge rates the risk as the same (strict) or partly the same (lenient). On 100 draft laws, the pipeline matches 0.28 of the findings within its top ten flags using the local Gemma 4 31B model, 0.30 with Sonnet 5.5, and 0.43-0.46 across all flags (non-blind; the frozen blind baseline achieves 0.21, 95% CI 0.16-0.26). Across all runs, most misses occur on provisions that the system located but qualified as a different risk, and none of the 32 legal-collision findings was matched. On 21 acts held out from tuning, the pipeline outperforms a monolithic prompt containing the full methodology under the strict measure, though not under the lenient one, and Opus 5.5 adds nothing over Sonnet. The reported scores reflect agreement with model-extracted findings rated by an LLM judge whose two access routes agree on 73 of 74 labels, without human expert validation.
items.title_ko: TRACE 프레임워크 기반 입법 초안의 반부패 전문성 자동화를 위한 AI 비서
items.summary_ko: TRACE 아키텍처를 기반으로 입법 초안의 부패 위험을 자동으로 평가하는 AI 비서를 제시합니다. 이 시스템은 전문가가 비판할 조항을 찾아내고 해당 규제 결함을 명시하며, 결정론적 파싱, 모델 기반 자격 부여, 규칙 기반 요인 할당, 인간 감독을 결합합니다.
items.why_ko: 법률 및 정책 분석 분야에서 AI의 활용 가능성을 보여주며, 복잡한 법률 문서 검토 프로세스를 자동화하고 효율성을 높이는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Dyship: Leveraging Acoustic Features For Speaker Relationship Classification From Dyadic Conversations
items.body: We introduce DyShip, a framework for classifying speaker familiarity and kinship from dyadic conversations in the Seamless Interaction corpus. We compare five speech representations: spectrograms, MFCCs, self-supervised WavLM representations, x-vectors, and estimated articulatory movements. Spectral features perform best for familiarity classification, reaching an accuracy of 87.81%, while WavLM achieves the highest kinship accuracy of 85.17%. X-vectors and articulatory features yield weaker results on familiarity classifiaction, but shine for kinship classification, with an AUC of 0.909 for x-vectors. Most classifiers exceed previously reported human and audio language model scores on the same dataset. These findings highlight the potential of conventional acoustic features for relationship inference and motivate further investigation of the conversational cues captured by different representations.
items.title_ko: Dyship: 이인 대화에서 화자 관계 분류를 위한 음향 특징 활용
items.summary_ko: DyShip은 Seamless Interaction 코퍼스에서 이인 대화의 화자 친밀도와 친족 관계를 분류하기 위한 프레임워크입니다. 스펙트로그램, MFCC, WavLM 표현 등 5가지 음성 표현을 비교하여 친밀도 분류 정확도 87.81%, 친족 분류 정확도 85.17%를 달성합니다.
items.why_ko: 음성 AI 분야에서 화자 관계 인식을 통해 대화형 AI의 사회적 지능을 향상시키고, 더 자연스러운 인간-AI 상호작용을 가능하게 합니다.

items.title: On Federated Averaging with Partial Participation under a General Variance Condition
items.body: In this paper, we study the convergence of Federated Averaging (FedAvg) with partial participation under a general variance condition. In each communication round, the server samples $S$ of the $n$ clients uniformly at random without replacement. The stochastic gradients are assumed to satisfy the so-called ABC condition, which allows their variance to grow with the local objective gaps. For smooth nonconvex objectives, we establish a finite-time stationarity bound in terms of the heterogeneity measure $σ_f^\star:=f^\star-\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^n f_i^\star$ and the client sampling factor $I_S:=(n-S)/(n-1)$. Here, $f^\star$ and $f_i^\star$ denote the infima of the global average objective and client $i$'s local objective, respectively. The bound exhibits a linear speedup in the number of sampled clients $S$ and recovers the full-participation result when $S=n$. Under diminishing stepsizes, we further prove that the gradient norm converges to zero both in expectation and almost surely. Notably, compared with existing analyses of FedAvg with partial participation, our results require no additional data heterogeneity assumption such as bounded gradient dissimilarity (BGD), and the sampling-induced term in our bound is not amplified by the number of local updates at the leading order. The importance of removing the BGD assumption is illustrated by an example that is smooth and lower bounded but violates BGD, yet is covered by our analysis.
items.title_ko: 일반 분산 조건 하에서 부분 참여를 통한 연합 평균화 수렴 연구
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 일반 분산 조건 하에서 부분 참여를 통한 연합 평균화(FedAvg)의 수렴을 연구합니다. 각 통신 라운드에서 서버는 $n$개의 클라이언트 중 $S$개를 무작위로 샘플링하며, 확률적 기울기가 ABC 조건을 만족한다고 가정합니다.
items.why_ko: 연합 학습(Federated Learning) 알고리즘의 수렴 특성을 이해하고 최적화하는 데 기여하며, 분산 환경에서 AI 모델을 훈련하는 개발자에게 중요한 이론적 통찰을 제공합니다.

items.title: StaRSE: Compact Russian Sentence Embeddings with a Sign-Coded Static Encoder
items.body: Transformer sentence encoders provide strong retrieval quality, but their inference cost becomes a bottleneck when embeddings must be produced on CPUs or refreshed frequently. We introduce StaRSE, a compact Russian static sentence encoder that removes Transformer inference at deployment time: token directions are stored as sign bits, token norms are stored separately, and sentences are encoded by mean pooling over norm-scaled sign directions. StaRSE is initialized from ruBERT-base, fine-tuned on Russian adjacent-sentence and task-shaped pairs, and post-trained with a contrastive stage that directly optimizes the sign-projected token table. On RuMTEB, StaRSE reaches a task mean of $51.16$, $7.98$ points above the strongest included static baseline. The packaged model occupies $11.3$ MiB and has a mean CPU latency of $0.08$ ms per sentence, compared with an estimated $55.7$ MiB 16-bit parameter footprint and $1.43$ ms mean CPU latency for the closest-quality contextual encoder. Ablations examine adjacent-sentence supervision, token norms, and direct sign-projected post-training.
items.title_ko: StaRSE: 부호 코딩 정적 인코더를 이용한 러시아어 문장 임베딩
items.summary_ko: StaRSE는 Transformer 추론 비용을 제거하여 배포 시점에 효율적인 러시아어 정적 문장 인코더입니다. 토큰 방향은 부호 비트로, 토큰 노름은 별도로 저장되며, 문장은 노름-스케일링된 부호 방향에 대한 평균 풀링으로 인코딩됩니다.
items.why_ko: 리소스 제약이 있는 환경에서 다국어 문장 임베딩의 효율성을 높여, 실시간 번역, 검색 시스템 등 다국어 AI 애플리케이션 개발에 활용될 수 있습니다.

items.title: Stagewise and interpretable emergence of inside-outside computation in Transformer-based language models
items.body: Variability in syntactic structure and parsing ambiguity are fundamental aspects of natural language which modern LLMs have to learn to deal with proficiently. Previous "post-mortem" studies have shown that fully trained Transformers indeed approximate canonical parsing algorithms such as inside-outside, but little is established theoretically about how this is actually learned. Here, we make a first step towards addressing this by studying the learning dynamics in synthetic context-free grammars with variable parse tree topology. The stagewise learning curves are fully interpretable, in the sense that all of the loss stages a) can be computed analytically, and b) can be clearly associated to the representation of a hidden latent tree variable, which allows to lift ambiguity and utilize information from wider contexts. By probing representations, we visualize the emergence of inside-outside computation across depth and during training: while during early stages local (bigram/trigram) information is used and involves only a few initial layers, gradually the Transformer develops an encoder-decoder structure where the most abstract latent information is encoded in the middle, and the latter half of the network is used to progressively refine the final token prediction. This organization of computation is reminiscent of findings in real-world LLMs, and importantly applies here to a synthetic model which allows full analytical control of the data statistics, thus opening the door to theoretical progress.
items.title_ko: 트랜스포머 기반 언어 모델에서 내부-외부 계산의 단계별 해석 가능한 출현
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 트랜스포머 기반 언어 모델이 어떻게 통사론적 구조와 파싱 모호성에 능숙하게 대처하는지, 특히 '내부-외부(inside-outside)'와 같은 정규 파싱 알고리즘을 근사화하는 과정을 이론적으로 탐구합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM의 언어 처리 메커니즘을 심층적으로 이해하는 데 기여하며, 특히 자연어 처리 모델의 설계 및 최적화에 대한 이론적 기반을 강화합니다.

items.title: Verifiable Agentic Traffic Class: A Policed Quality-of-Service Mechanism for Agentic AI Traffic, Evaluated from Simulation to Real-Kernel Adversarial Testing
items.body: Software agents built on large language models generate traffic unlike human web traffic, yet routers have no class for it and cannot verify a sender's claim to be an agent. This paper proposes the Verifiable Agentic Traffic Class (VATC), which combines a reserved Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) value declaring agent traffic, a router-side classifier that demotes flows contradicting the declaration to a class served after best-effort traffic, and a rate-limited priority queue. VATC was compared with static Differentiated Services (DiffServ), a dedicated class that trusts the marking, and fq_codel, a per-flow fair-queuing scheduler, in two simulators and on a real Linux kernel. VATC matched DiffServ under steady load. In a constructed burst it cut mean agent queuing delay by 98% relative to DiffServ in simulation (assuming an immediate verdict), at a 12% increase in human delay; most of the gain came from the separate class. Under a spoofed flood in the kernel, the rate limit held human latency 11 times below DiffServ's. Without verification, DiffServ and a tightly configured fq_codel gave legitimate agents lower latency than VATC; a live four-feature classifier then demoted all 20 bulk-shaped spoofers and gave agents 0.30 ms, but missed six spoofers that copied the agent pattern. With emulated network delay, a timing feature of the classifier stopped separating agent from human flows. In real agent harnesses on a congested link, router queueing took 13% to 63% of task time, depending on harness and assumed model latency. The traffic was synthetic or sandbox-scale.
items.title_ko: Verifiable Agentic Traffic Class: 에이전트 AI 트래픽을 위한 QoS 메커니즘
items.summary_ko: VATC(Verifiable Agentic Traffic Class)는 라우터가 발신자의 에이전트 주장(Differentiated Services Code Point, DSCP 값)을 검증하고, 이를 위반하는 흐름을 우선순위가 낮은 클래스로 강등하는 정책 기반 QoS 메커니즘입니다.
items.why_ko: AI 에이전트 트래픽을 관리하고 최적화하는 새로운 네트워크 QoS(서비스 품질) 메커니즘을 제시하여, AI 기반 네트워크 서비스의 안정성과 효율성을 높이는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Tree-Ising: Repairing Language Models with Bit-Level Ising Edits
items.body: Weight-space programming, introduced in recent MIT work by Takehi et al., enables a frontier LLM agent to read a network's weights and write a repair. Their GPT-6 Astra agent corrected the reasoning loops of Qwen3.5-0.8B without gradients, using 158 agent turns, 89.7 million tokens, and 50 forward-pass requests. Our method, Tree-Ising, casts this repair as a sparse discrete optimization problem over the model's own BF16 weights. Forward statistics define an objective that weakens a loop direction, strengthens a concluding direction, and preserves the layer's output on productive tokens. Within a state-tree representation, where lossless BF16 storage acts as a special case, the admissible edits are sign flips and exponent shifts that preserve all shared group exponents and mantissas. We decompose this objective exactly into independent QUBO (Ising) problems, one per output row, which we solve on a GPU using simulated annealing or quantum-inspired simulated bifurcation. On the agent's two layers, Tree-Ising achieves 54.6% on MATH-500, outperforming the agent's edit (51.7%) under the same evaluation protocol, while the base model scores 7.9% as reported. The simulated bifurcation solver yields a statistically indistinguishable repair at 55.1%. Both solvers outperform the agent edit across all five math benchmarks, with statistically significant improvements on MATH-500 and GSM8K after correcting for multiple comparisons. Our approach modifies 13% to 17% fewer weights and reduces BF16 bit flips by a factor of 2.2 to 2.3. It requires only four forward-pass requests and zero LLM tokens, with the annealing recipe costing about $0.90 in GPU time. On Qwen3.5-2B, with layers and dose selected using only the base model, the same recipe increases greedy GSM8K accuracy from 21.6% to 69.4%. As a proof of concept, we execute an eight-variable repair subproblem using QAOA on an IBM Heron processor.
items.body_ko: 최근 MIT에서 Takehi 등이 발표한 Weight-space programming은 최전선 LLM 에이전트가 네트워크의 가중치를 읽고 수정을 작성할 수 있도록 합니다. 그들의 GPT-6 Astra 에이전트는 Qwen3.5-0.8B의 추론 루프를 그래디언트 없이 158번의 에이전트 턴, 8,970만 토큰, 그리고 50번의 순방향 패스 요청을 사용하여 수정했습니다. 우리의 방법인 Tree-Ising은 이 수정을 모델 자체의 BF16 가중치에 대한 희소한 이산 최적화 문제로 다룹니다. 순방향 통계는 루프 방향을 약화시키고, 결론 방향을 강화하며, 생산적인 토큰에 대한 레이어 출력을 보존하는 목표를 정의합니다. 손실 없는 BF16 스토리지가 특수한 경우로 작용하는 상태 트리 표현 내에서, 허용 가능한 수정은 모든 공유 그룹 지수와 가수(mantissas)를 보존하는 부호 반전 및 지수 이동입니다. 우리는 이 목표를 독립적인 QUBO (Ising) 문제로 정확하게 분해하며, 각 출력 행마다 하나씩, 시뮬레이션된 어닐링 또는 양자 영감 시뮬레이션된 분기(simulated bifurcation)를 사용하여 GPU에서 해결합니다. 에이전트의 두 레이어에서 Tree-Ising은 MATH-500에서 54.6%를 달성하여 동일한 평가 프로토콜에서 에이전트의 수정(51.7%)을 능가하며, 베이스 모델은 7.9%를 기록했습니다. 시뮬레이션된 분기 솔버는 55.1%로 통계적으로 구별할 수 없는 수정을 제공합니다. 두 솔버 모두 모든 5가지 수학 벤치마크에서 에이전트 수정을 능가하며, 다중 비교에 대한 보정 후 MATH-500 및 GSM8K에서 통계적으로 유의미한 개선을 보입니다. 우리의 접근 방식은 13%에서 17% 더 적은 가중치를 수정하고 BF16 비트 플립을 2.2배에서 2.3배 줄입니다. 단 4번의 순방향 패스 요청과 0개의 LLM 토큰이 필요하며, 어닐링 레시피는 GPU 시간으로 약 $0.90의 비용이 듭니다. Qwen3.5-2B에서, 베이스 모델만을 사용하여 레이어와 용량을 선택한 동일한 레시피는 그리디 GSM8K 정확도를 21.6%에서 69.4%로 증가시킵니다. 개념 증명으로, 우리는 IBM Heron 프로세서에서 QAOA를 사용하여 8변수 수정 하위 문제를 실행합니다.
items.title_ko: Tree-Ising: 비트 수준 이징 편집으로 언어 모델 수리
items.summary_ko: Tree-Ising은 LLM 에이전트가 네트워크의 가중치를 읽고 수리할 수 있도록 하는 '가중치 공간 프로그래밍' 방법입니다. 기존 방식이 158번의 에이전트 턴과 수백만 개의 토큰을 사용했던 것과 달리, 이 방법은 모델의 BF16 가중치에 대한 희소 이산 최적화 문제로 캐스팅됩니다.
items.why_ko: LLM의 행동을 직접적이고 효율적으로 수정하고 개선할 수 있는 새로운 메커니즘을 제공하여, LLM의 디버깅 및 최적화 프로세스를 혁신할 잠재력이 있습니다.

items.title: Breakdown of Autoregressive Multi-Step Reasoning Under Concentrated vs. Diffuse Attention Head Dropout
items.body: During extended wakefulness, mammalian neocortical networks experience localized periods of transient neuronal silence termed off-states. Here, we examine how analogous spatiotemporally concentrated disruptions affect sequential reasoning in autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs). Evaluating 250 paired derivations on the GSM8K benchmark across two 8B models (Qwen3-8B and LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct), we contrast clustered bursts of attention head masking against budget-matched diffuse i.i.d. dropout. Concentrated bursts induce substantial reasoning degradation: at onset parameter $\mathcal{B}=0.10$ (scheduling $\sim 5.7\%$ of vulnerable head-token volume), Qwen3-8B accuracy drops from $91.2\%$ under diffuse noise to $78.8\%$ under burst dropout ($Δ= -12.4$ percentage points [pp], exact McNemar $p = 5.5 \times 10^{-6}$), while LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct drops from $84.0\%$ to $76.8\%$ ($Δ= -7.2$ pp, $p = 0.0198$). Conversely, dispersing the identical cumulative budget uniformly across generation steps via stratified quintile matching yields substantially milder degradation (retaining $91.2\%$ in Qwen and $84.0\%$ in LLaMA). In an exploratory factorial dissociation ($N=100$), single-step dropout density is associated with an acute drop in a single schedule draw ($-10.0$ pp on Qwen, $p_{\text{holm}} = 0.0425$), while multi-token continuity exhibits an inconclusive compounding trend ($-7.0$ pp, $p_{\text{holm}} = 0.1892$). Error analysis reveals that Qwen failures reflect derivation errors within formatted responses (conditional accuracy drop of $-11.4$ pp), whereas in LLaMA $22.2\%$ of discordant losses lack a final answer format line (conditional gap narrows to $-5.0$ pp). These findings demonstrate that autoregressive reasoning chains are particularly vulnerable to concentrated structural disruptions, providing empirical benchmarks for fault tolerance in transformer architectures.
items.title_ko: 집중형 vs. 분산형 어텐션 헤드 드롭아웃 하에서 자기회귀 다단계 추론의 붕괴
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 자기회귀 LLM에서 어텐션 헤드 드롭아웃(집중형 또는 분산형)이 순차적 추론에 미치는 영향을 GSM8K 벤치마크를 통해 분석합니다. 이는 LLM의 안정성과 강건성에 대한 이해를 돕습니다.
items.why_ko: LLM의 강건성을 이해하고 모델 안정성을 향상시키는 데 중요한 통찰을 제공하여, LLM 기반 시스템의 신뢰성을 높이는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Joint Quantization and Dynamic Partitioning for Context-Aware Edge Vision Transformers
items.body: Deploying vision transformer models across connected and automated vehicles (CAVs) requires joint management of computation and Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) communication. Static split-inference methods use fixed partition points and cannot adapt to time-varying link bandwidth, processing load, and concurrent multi-stream traffic. This paper proposes an edge orchestration framework that jointly selects model partition points, per-layer quantization bitwidths, and execution placement across heterogeneous vehicular compute nodes. The joint partitioning and mixed-precision allocation problem is formulated as a Mixed-Integer Linear Program (MILP) that minimizes compute and communication energy subject to end-to-end latency and task-quality constraints. The framework is evaluated on Jetson Orin Nano (8~GB), Jetson Orin NX (16~GB), and Jetson AGX Orin (32~GB) nodes using OPV2V-driven multi-stream workloads with $K \in \{2,4,6,8\}$. Across the evaluated configurations, the proposed formulation reduces V2V communication energy by $33.3$--$36.0\%$ relative to a Uniform INT8 split. At $K=8$, end-to-end task completion latency is reduced by $34.0\%$ on the Orin Nano and $33.1\%$ on the Orin NX relative to the same baseline, while limiting the reduction in 3D detection accuracy to $3.1$--$4.1$ percentage points in $\mathrm{mAP}_{50}$ relative to FP16 execution.
items.title_ko: 컨텍스트 인식 엣지 비전 트랜스포머를 위한 공동 양자화 및 동적 분할
items.summary_ko: 연결 및 자율 차량(CAV)에 비전 트랜스포머 모델을 배포하기 위한 엣지 오케스트레이션 프레임워크를 제안합니다. 이는 모델 분할 지점, 계층별 양자화 비트 너비, 이기종 엣지 장치 간 실행 배치를 동적으로 선택하여 계산 및 V2V 통신을 공동으로 관리합니다.
items.why_ko: 엣지 환경에서 비전 트랜스포머 모델의 효율성과 적응성을 극대화하여, 자율 주행 및 IoT 애플리케이션의 AI 배포에 중요한 기술 발전을 가져옵니다.

items.title: An Augmented Lagrangian Approach to Lifted Bellman Linear Programming
items.body: Temporal-difference critics regress onto a bootstrapped target and usually need a target network. Lifted Bellman Linear Programming (LBLP) instead expresses the in-sample optimal values of offline RL as the solution to a linear program over the dataset. Its neural solver ALBUM relaxes the constraints into hinge penalties with fixed coefficients, and its guarantees are conditions on coefficients chosen in advance. We solve the same program with the method of multipliers: the coefficients become multipliers learned by dual ascent, with one penalty parameter $ρ$. In the convex case the fixed points are the KKT pairs of LBLP, and at every stationary point the applied constraint weights balance the objective exactly. The critic can serve a Gaussian actor, a flow actor, and best-of-N sampling, and for the Gaussian actor we propose an advantage-normalized DDPG+BC objective. With a single $Q$ and $V$ and no target network, our AL-LBLP with best-of-N reaches 60.1\% average success on the 50 state-based OGBench tasks. On long-horizon tasks, it reaches 81.5% on humanoidmaze-giant and 79.8% on antmaze-giant. It does not collapse up to batch size 8192.
items.title_ko: 리프트된 벨만 선형 프로그래밍에 대한 증강 라그랑지안 접근 방식
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 오프라인 강화 학습(RL)의 인-샘플 최적 값을 데이터셋에 대한 선형 프로그램으로 표현하는 리프트된 벨만 선형 프로그래밍(LBLP)에 대한 증강 라그랑지안 접근 방식을 제안합니다. 이는 제약 조건을 페널티로 완화하는 기존 방식의 한계를 극복합니다.
items.why_ko: 오프라인 강화 학습의 이론적 기반을 강화하고, 최적화 알고리즘의 효율성을 향상시켜 RL 기반 AI 시스템 개발에 기여합니다.

items.title: SpecValley: Aggregation as Spectral Valley in Dense Heterophilic Graphs
items.body: Node classification in heterophilic graphs remains an open problem: aggregating over neighbourhoods can damp precisely the part of the signal that carries the labels. The field has answered with ever more expressive propagation operators, leaving the aggregation step that precedes them fixed by degree normalisation. However, degree normalisation acts as a spectral valley in its own right, attenuating a fixed middle band whose position at lambda equal 1 is set by the normalisation rather than by the data, exactly where the eigenvalues of dense graphs accumulate. We therefore begin with the representations rather than the propagation, in two stages: a learnable aggregation followed by an ordinary spectral filter. The first, SpecValley learns the position, sharpness and flank gains of the valley for every graph. We show formally how the aggregation operator and downstream filter interact. We establish that the response 1 minus lambda of degree normalisation vanishes exactly at that accumulation point. A spectral energy budget shows that what aggregation removes from a band, no linear spectral filter can recover. Crowding alone says nothing about the benefit. That is decided by how much label energy the valley removes, which we measure for every graph. SpecValley achieves strong results across heterophilic benchmarks, and a controlled ablation over aggregation operators and downstream filters attributes the gain to aggregation rather than the filter.
items.title_ko: SpecValley: 밀집 이종 그래프에서 스펙트럴 밸리로서의 집계
items.summary_ko: 이종 그래프에서의 노드 분류 문제에서, 이웃에 대한 집계가 레이블을 전달하는 신호의 일부를 약화시킬 수 있음을 지적합니다. 이 논문은 기존의 고정된 집계 단계가 스펙트럴 밸리(spectral valley)처럼 작동하여 특정 대역의 신호를 감쇠시키는 것을 분석합니다.
items.why_ko: 그래프 신경망(GNN)의 이종 그래프 처리 능력을 향상시키는 데 기여하며, 복잡한 네트워크 데이터 분석 분야의 AI 애플리케이션 개발에 중요합니다.

items.title: Cross-Border Fulfillment Center Selection via Doubly Robust Estimation and Linear Programming
items.body: We introduce the cross-border (XB) fulfillment center (FC) Selection Model: a multi-stage optimization framework combining forecasting, doubly robust estimation, and linear programming to select optimal source FCs. For each source-destination shipping arc, the objective is to choose a subset of source-country FCs that minimize delivery time and cost while maximizing profit and shipped units under a fixed domestic network. We evaluate the model on three production-scale international shipping corridors for a large e-commerce company using 12 months of shipment data, employing both aggregate offline replay and shipment-level counterfactual nearest-neighbor matching. Across all shipping corridors, the XB FC Selection Model achieves 8.5-51.1% reductions in delivery time and 4.4-48.3% reductions in logistics cost relative to human expert-defined FC selection policies, with up to 6.5 percentage-point improvements in 5/5 target compliance (5 days, $5 USD). Pareto analysis shows the model consistently dominates single-objective ranking strategies and unconstrained LP on the efficiency-reallocation frontier, with all results statistically significant.
items.title_ko: 강화 학습을 활용한 국경 간 물류 센터 최적화 모델
items.summary_ko: 본 연구는 국경 간 물류 센터(FC) 선택을 위한 다단계 최적화 프레임워크인 XB FC 선택 모델을 소개합니다. 이 모델은 예측, 이중 강건 추정, 선형 프로그래밍을 결합하여 최적의 출발지 FC를 선택합니다. 국내 네트워크가 고정된 상태에서 배송 시간과 비용을 최소화하고 수익 및 배송 단위를 최대화하는 것을 목표로 합니다.
items.why_ko: 물류 및 공급망 최적화에 관심 있는 개발자라면 강화 학습과 최적화 기법이 실제 비즈니스 문제에 어떻게 적용될 수 있는지 참고할 만한 연구입니다.

items.title: BARS: Budget-Aware Sequential Sampling with Refusal for Majority Identification under Unknown Distributions
items.body: Repeated sampling with majority selection is an effective means of enforcing self-consistency in large language models. Recently, a variant has also been introduced that terminates early to save costs when the output distribution is favorable. But it still cannot yield a correct confidence estimate from the answer distribution. For this issue, we formalize this as majority identification under an unknown distribution with a budget and a target error rate, and propose BARS, a sequential rule certifying the top-two gap and returning an early stop, a budgeted majority vote, or a refusal when feasibility cannot be established. A refusal is a statement about the rule and its budget, not a claim that a question is unanswerable, and it tells practitioners when to widen the budget or switch models. A certified mode carries proven bounds on the joint answering error and on refusing an instance the budget could handle, while a practical mode, used in our experiments, replaces them with empirical calibration. On synthetic instances drawn from known distributions over thousands of seeds, the difficulty-driven behavior is recovered and the price of the certified mode is measured.On GSM8K the practical mode draws 22.3\% fewer samples than fixed-8 sampling over the same pool, refused questions included, at the cost of declining 18.8\% of the questions. On MATH, it greatly improves the accuracy of its output answers into 82.5\% at the cost of honestly refusing to answer half of the difficult questions that the model itself is unable to solve.
items.title_ko: 예산 제약 하에 불확실한 분포에서 다수결을 식별하는 순차 샘플링 기법 BARS
items.summary_ko: LLM의 자기 일관성 강화를 위한 반복 샘플링 및 다수결 선택 기법에서, BARS(Budget-Aware Sequential Sampling with Refusal)는 예산과 목표 오류율 제약 하에 불확실한 분포에서 다수결을 식별하는 순차 샘플링 규칙을 제안합니다. 이 기법은 이전 방식들이 정확한 신뢰도 추정치를 제공하지 못했던 문제를 해결합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM의 출력 품질과 일관성, 그리고 효율적인 샘플링 전략에 관심 있는 개발자에게 유용한 정보가 될 수 있습니다.

items.title: Representational Atoms in Neural Networks
items.body: Understanding the internal representations of neural networks and characterizing their relationship with human conceptual structure are two critical questions for elucidating model mechanisms. The former reveals how learned knowledge is organized in internal representations, whereas the latter provides a basis for interpreting these representations through human conceptual structure. Here, we formally define fundamental representational units (FRUs) and establish two evaluation criteria: fidelity and stability. We further prove that threshold-activated sparse autoencoders (TSAEs) can identify FRUs with high fidelity and stability under appropriate conditions, and validate this result through large-scale experiments. Further analyses reveal that FRUs with higher stability exhibit greater monosemanticity and can be composed across layers to recover semantic organization corresponding to human conceptual structure. These results provide a unified framework for defining, evaluating and identifying FRUs in neural networks, and establish a foundation for characterizing the relationship between neural network representations and human conceptual structure.
items.title_ko: 신경망 내부 표현의 '원자적' 단위 발견 연구
items.summary_ko: 신경망의 내부 표현을 이해하고 이를 인간의 개념 구조와 연관 짓는 것은 모델 메커니즘을 밝히는 데 중요합니다. 이 연구는 '근본적인 표현 단위(FRU, Fundamental Representational Units)'를 정식으로 정의하고, 충실도 및 구성성이라는 두 가지 평가 기준을 제시하여 신경망이 학습한 지식을 어떻게 조직하는지 분석합니다.
items.why_ko: 모델의 내부 작동 방식을 이해하고 해석 가능한 AI(XAI) 분야에 관심 있는 연구자나 개발자에게 신경망의 블랙박스 문제를 해결하는 새로운 접근법을 제시합니다.

items.title: Nonadaptive One-Sided Testing of Binary Rank
items.body: The binary rank of a binary matrix is the minimum number of disjoint all-one rectangles that partition its one-entries. We study entry-query testing of binary rank at most $d$, with one-sided error and nonadaptive queries. We give a tester using $\tilde O(d^4/ε^2)$ queries, independent of the matrix dimensions and a general lower bound of $\tilde Ω(d^{3/2}/ε)$.
items.title_ko: 이진 행렬의 이진 랭크 테스트를 위한 비적응적 단측 검사 기법
items.summary_ko: 이진 행렬의 이진 랭크(d)가 최대 d인지 테스트하는 비적응적 단측 오차 쿼리 기법을 연구합니다. 제안된 테스터는 행렬 크기에 독립적으로 O(d^4/ε^2) 쿼리를 사용하며, 일반적인 하한은 Ω(d^(3/2)/ε)입니다.
items.why_ko: 이론 컴퓨터 과학 및 알고리즘 분야의 매우 전문적인 연구로, 일반적인 AI 개발자에게 직접적인 영향은 적습니다.

items.title: Unipolar Neuron Networks Trained by Recirculation for Reward-Based Continual Learning
items.body: Unipolar neurons are the predominant type of nerve cell in the octopus and in most other invertebrates. A single neurite (a fiber extending from the cell body) branches into a tree that carries both input and output synapses. The branches send graded local outputs to nearby cells, and one site on the main neurite sends a global output to distant targets. This paper proposes a network of such neurons and a learning rule for it. Each neuron is modeled as a tree of passive segments, whose activations are computed exactly as the steady state of a linear system. The network learns from reward alone, with a rule called recirculation. After each forward pass, a second pass sends requested changes of the outputs back through the same connections. Each synapse then adjusts its weight using only quantities available at its own location. Because the system of each neuron is symmetric, this update closely follows the gradient of the error in the predicted reward. Two mechanisms limit forgetting when tasks are learned in sequence: a task code inhibits a different subset of branches in each task, while consolidation lowers the learning rate of synapses that changed strongly in the recent past. The model is evaluated on a sequence of MNIST and Iris tasks. The network maintains high accuracy with low forgetting, whereas gradient-based training of the same network forgets earlier tasks almost completely.
items.title_ko: 보상 기반 지속 학습을 위한 단극 뉴런 네트워크 및 학습 규칙 제안
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 문어와 같은 무척추동물에 흔한 단극 뉴런을 모델링한 네트워크와 학습 규칙을 제안합니다. 각 뉴런은 수동적인 세그먼트 트리로 모델링되며, 활동은 인접 세포에 등급화된 지역 출력을 보내고 주 뉴라이트의 한 지점에서 원거리 대상에 전역 출력을 보냅니다.
items.why_ko: 생물학적 영감을 받은 신경망 구조 및 지속 학습 분야에 관심 있는 연구자들에게 새로운 모델 아키텍처와 학습 패러다임을 탐구하는 기회를 제공합니다.

items.title: Deviation-Aware Pretraining for Cardiovascular Disease Detection from Electrocardiograms
items.body: Electrocardiogram (ECG) signals are critical for cardiovascular disease (CVD) detection. Most current deep learning models rely on supervised, task-specific training, which limits their ability to generalize across diseases, patient populations, and acquisition settings. This paper presents a self-supervised ECG feature extraction framework that learns from nearly one million unlabeled 12-lead ECG recordings. The framework includes two modules: Deviation Localization Embedding (DLE), which detects waveform-level deviations from normal patterns, and Association Reconstruction Embedding (ARE), which models cross-lead associations through deviation-guided reconstruction to capture abnormal patterns expressed across multiple leads. These modules enable the framework to capture subtle deviation-related patterns and their cross-lead context. The framework achieves up to 6.5% AUROC and 12.8% F1 improvements over prior methods on multiple public datasets, even without additional fine-tuning the pretrained feature extractor. Embedding visualizations show that the learned features support meaningful disease grouping and anomaly identification. The approach reduces the need for labeled data and can support clinicians in diverse healthcare settings. The framework has potential to improve early detection and monitoring of cardiovascular diseases, contributing to more accessible and equitable heart care.
items.title_ko: ECG 기반 심혈관 질환 감지를 위한 편차 인식 사전 학습 프레임워크
items.summary_ko: 심전도(ECG) 신호는 심혈관 질환(CVD) 감지에 중요하지만, 기존 딥러닝 모델은 지도 학습에 의존하여 일반화 능력이 제한적입니다. 본 논문은 약 100만 개의 레이블 없는 12-리드 ECG 기록으로 학습하는 자체 지도 ECG 특징 추출 프레임워크를 제안하며, 편차 위치 임베딩(DLE)을 포함한 두 가지 모듈로 구성됩니다.
items.why_ko: 의료 AI, 특히 ECG 분석 분야 개발자에게 레이블링된 데이터 부족 문제를 해결하고 모델의 일반화 능력을 향상시킬 수 있는 효과적인 자체 지도 학습 기법을 제시합니다.

items.title: HaiRuo: Forecasting Ocean Eddies as Fields and Objects with a Satellite-Altimetry Foundation Model
items.body: Mesoscale eddies carry most of the ocean's kinetic energy and move heat, salt and nutrients across basins, yet where an eddy will be two weeks ahead is still read off ocean models with post-hoc tracking heuristics. We introduce HaiRuo, which forecasts eddies as fields and as objects at once: from 30 days of satellite sea-level maps, one forward pass returns 15 days of sea level and geostrophic velocity, daily eddy masks and the trajectory of every eddy alive today. HaiRuo pairs two components with a clear division of labour: (1) HaiRuo-1B, an open-weight 1.05-billion-parameter foundation model pretrained without labels on 24 years of global satellite-altimetry observations, which supplies the 15-day physical fields and masks (+0.14 field skill and +1.1 mIoU points under the same decoder) and further lowers 15-day centre error by 1.2 km frozen (1.35 km over training from scratch); and (2) XuanJi, a Lagrangian object decoder that samples the evolving forecast in each eddy's co-moving polar frame and refines the 15-day path across three look-ahead rounds, removing 2.5 km on HaiRuo-1B (2.9 km with joint fine-tuning) and 2.5-3.3 km via its object attention across six published backbones. Under one pre-registered global evaluation over the whole ocean, HaiRuo improves on fourteen methods on every endpoint (25.2 vs. 30.6 km 15-day centre error, -18%), holding its margin outside the labelled regions and through both phases of the El Nino-Southern Oscillation (ENSO), while reproducing westward drift, 50-60 deg S eastward reversal and poleward cyclone-anticyclone deflection. Over ten days through one fixed tracker, HaiRuo's forecast field cuts the eddy-centre error of WenHai and XiHe by 37-43% (-2.8 km vs. day 0 while they degrade +4.3-8.7 km), and its object trajectories cut pipeline error by 77-78% globally. Open-weight checkpoints, code and project page: https://github.com/xkqin/HaiRuo
items.body_ko: 중규모 해양 와류는 해양 운동 에너지의 대부분을 운반하며 분지를 가로질러 열, 염분, 영양분을 이동시키지만, 2주 후 와류가 어디에 있을지는 여전히 사후 추적 발견법을 통해 해양 모델에서 읽어냅니다. 우리는 와류를 필드와 객체로서 동시에 예측하는 HaiRuo를 소개합니다. 30일간의 위성 해수면 지도에서 단 한 번의 순방향 패스로 15일간의 해수면 및 지형류 속도, 일일 와류 마스크, 그리고 오늘 살아있는 모든 와류의 궤적을 반환합니다. HaiRuo는 명확한 역할 분담을 가진 두 가지 구성 요소를 결합합니다. (1) HaiRuo-1B는 24년간의 전지구 위성 고도 측정 관측 데이터로 라벨 없이 사전 학습된 오픈 웨이트 10억 5천만 개 파라미터 기반 모델로, 15일간의 물리 필드와 마스크를 제공하며(동일한 디코더에서 +0.14 필드 스킬 및 +1.1 mIoU 포인트), 15일 중심 오차를 정지 상태에서 1.2km 추가로 줄입니다(스크래치 학습 시 1.35km 감소). (2) XuanJi는 각 와류의 공회전 극좌표계에서 진화하는 예측을 샘플링하고 세 번의 미래 예측 라운드를 통해 15일 경로를 정제하는 Lagrangian 객체 디코더로, HaiRuo-1B에서 2.5km(공동 미세 조정 시 2.9km), 6개의 공개된 백본에서 객체 어텐션을 통해 2.5-3.3km를 제거합니다. 전체 해양에 대한 사전 등록된 전지구 평가에서 HaiRuo는 모든 종단점(15일 중심 오차 25.2km 대 30.6km, -18%)에서 14가지 방법을 능가하며, 라벨링되지 않은 영역 외부와 엘니뇨-남방 진동(ENSO)의 두 단계 모두에서 마진을 유지하고, 서쪽으로의 이동, 남위 50-60도 동쪽으로의 반전, 극방향 사이클론-반사이클론 편향을 재현합니다. 고정된 추적기를 통한 10일 동안, HaiRuo의 예측 필드는 WenHai와 XiHe의 와류 중심 오차를 37-43%(-2.8km 대 0일, 그들은 +4.3-8.7km 악화) 줄이고, 그 객체 궤적은 전 세계적으로 파이프라인 오차를 77-78% 줄입니다. 오픈 웨이트 체크포인트, 코드 및 프로젝트 페이지: https://github.com/xkqin/HaiRuo
items.title_ko: 위성 고도계 기반 해양 와류 예측 파운데이션 모델 HaiRuo 공개
items.summary_ko: HaiRuo는 해양 와류를 필드와 객체로 동시에 예측하는 새로운 파운데이션 모델입니다. 30일간의 위성 해수면 지도를 입력으로 받아 15일간의 해수면 및 지형류 속도, 일별 와류 마스크, 현재 활동 중인 모든 와류의 궤적을 예측합니다. 이 모델은 두 가지 구성 요소를 결합하여 와류를 물리적으로 일관되게 예측합니다.
items.why_ko: 기후 모델링, 해양학 연구 및 위성 데이터 분석 분야에서 예측의 정확도를 획기적으로 향상시킬 수 있는 잠재력을 가진 모델이며, 대규모 시공간 데이터 처리 기술을 보여줍니다.

items.title: Right for the Wrong Reasons? Evaluating Plausibility and Behavioral Change in Explanation-Guided Learning
items.body: Explanation-Guided Learning (EGL) promises models that are not only accurate but also rely on task-relevant evidence. However, whether improved agreement between model explanations and human-provided rationales also implies a changed decision strategy remains unclear. We study this tension under controlled synthetic shortcut introduction using a constructed shortcut dataset. Inspired by real-world applications, our benchmark covers shortcuts of different kinds, including localized, background-based, and global cues. This allows us to evaluate whether different EGL objectives produce behavioral changesand explanatory changes. Across these axes, we find that the effects of EGL are strongly objective-specific. Rationale-based data augmentation provides the clearest robustness gains when shortcut evidence can be separated from task-relevant foreground information, reaching average accuracy improvements of up to +4.8 percentage points (pp) together with increased foreground reliance. Attribution-constraining objectives primarily improve explanation plausibility, increasing Importance Mass by up to +14 pp on average, but provide weaker and less consistent behavioral correction, with average accuracy gains of at most +1.6 pp. Moreover, neither improved robustness nor improved plausibility reliably implies higher perturbation-based fidelity. Overall, our results show that EGL can be useful, but its success cannot be inferred from rationale agreement alone and should instead be evaluated along complementary behavioral and explanation-level axes. We publicly release all experimental results to enable further analysis (https://right-for-wrong-reasons.dfki.de/).
items.title_ko: 설명 기반 학습에서 설명의 타당성 및 행동 변화 평가 연구
items.summary_ko: 설명 기반 학습(EGL)은 정확할 뿐만 아니라 작업 관련 증거에 의존하는 모델을 약속하지만, 모델 설명과 인간이 제공하는 합리화 사이의 일치 개선이 의사 결정 전략의 변화를 의미하는지는 불분명합니다. 이 연구는 통제된 합성 단축키 도입을 사용하여 이러한 긴장 관계를 조사합니다.
items.why_ko: 설명 가능한 AI(XAI)의 핵심적인 과제인 모델의 '설명이 진짜인지'를 평가하는 방법에 대한 심도 있는 고민을 제공하며, 모델의 신뢰성 확보에 관심 있는 개발자에게 중요합니다.

items.title: Continuous 3D Spatial Transcriptomics Reconstruction via Histology-Informed Implicit Neural Representations
items.body: Three-dimensional spatial transcriptomics (3D ST) enables the analysis of gene-expression patterns across tissue depths. However, 3D ST measurements are acquired from discrete 2D tissue sections, which are often sparsely sampled due to high acquisition costs. To address this limitation, we propose a histology-informed multi-task implicit neural representation (HIM-INR) for continuous 3D gene-expression reconstruction from sparse ST observations. HIM-INR jointly reconstructs gene-expression profiles and histological representations using an INR with a shared backbone, leveraging densely sampled histological images as auxiliary spatial supervision. Once trained, HIM-INR predicts gene expression at arbitrary 3D coordinates without requiring histological images. Experiments on two 3D ST datasets demonstrate improved reconstruction over existing methods, particularly as the number of missing ST sections increases.
items.title_ko: 조직학 정보를 활용한 연속 3D 공간 전사체 재구성 신경망 HIM-INR
items.summary_ko: 3차원 공간 전사체(3D ST)는 조직 깊이에 따른 유전자 발현 패턴 분석을 가능하게 하지만, 데이터 획득 비용으로 인해 2D 단면 데이터가 희소한 경우가 많습니다. 본 논문은 희소한 ST 관측치로부터 연속적인 3D 유전자 발현을 재구성하기 위해 조직학 정보를 활용한 다중 작업 암시적 신경망(HIM-INR)을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 생물학 및 의료 이미지 분석 분야의 개발자들에게 희소한 데이터로부터 고해상도 3D 재구성을 가능하게 하는 혁신적인 접근법을 제시합니다.

items.title: Hierarchical Graph Representation Learning with Pooling-Induced Substructures
items.body: Hierarchical graph-level tasks that require reasoning over substructures that extend beyond local neighborhoods are posing challenges for standard Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). While graph pooling aims to address this by coarsening graphs into hierarchical representations, existing methods often fail to explicitly preserve the substructures they induce, leading to inconsistent empirical performance. Moreover, evaluating such approaches remains challenging due to the lack of benchmarks with explicit hierarchical structure. We propose Pooled-Substructure-Aware GNNs, an approach to graph pooling that explicitly preserves and processes substructures uncovered by structure-based pooling schemes. We show that this design enhances the expressive power of pooling-based GNNs in the sense of the Weisfeiler-Lehman (WL) test. To enable principled evaluation, we introduce two new synthetic datasets with controllable hierarchical structure and propose a metric to characterize the prevalence of hierarchical patterns in real-world graph-level benchmarks. On tasks with relevant hierarchical structure, our approach outperforms matched pooling baselines, while remaining competitive on structurally simpler benchmarks. Code and datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/lsbicego/PSA-GNN/.
items.title_ko: 풀링 기반 하위 구조를 이용한 계층적 그래프 표현 학습
items.summary_ko: 그래프 신경망(GNN)은 지역 이웃을 넘어서는 하위 구조에 대한 추론을 요구하는 계층적 그래프 수준 작업에 어려움을 겪습니다. 그래프 풀링은 그래프를 계층적 표현으로 coarsening하여 이를 해결하려 하지만, 기존 방법들은 유도된 하위 구조를 명시적으로 보존하지 못해 일관성 없는 성능을 보입니다. 본 연구는 이러한 문제를 해결할 새로운 접근법을 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: 그래프 데이터 처리 및 GNN 아키텍처 개선에 관심 있는 개발자에게 그래프의 계층적 구조를 효과적으로 학습하고 활용하는 새로운 방법을 제시합니다.

items.title: CroCoMAE: Cross-modal self-supervised collaborative representation learning for SAR-optical remote sensing data
items.body: Remote sensing increasingly captures the Earth's surface through complementary sensors such as SAR and optical, yet ground-truth annotations remain scarce, limiting supervised approaches. Self-supervised learning (SSL) addresses the label scarcity, and cross-modal SSL further exploits the complementarity between co-located sensors, but existing cross-modal frameworks align modalities mostly through global image-level representations or treat them as largely redundant, leaving their fine-grained complementary structure underexploited. We propose CroCoMAE, a cross-modal SSL framework for SAR-optical remote sensing that unifies contrastive learning and masked image modeling within a ViT-based architecture, operating at two complementary levels. At the image level, an intra-modality contrastive loss on the class token yields globally discriminative, augmentation-invariant representations. At the patch level, masked image modeling drives fine-grained per-modality representations, while a cross-modal contrastive objective aligns a shared subspace across SAR and optical patch tokens, leaving the complementary subspace unconstrained to retain modality-specific information. On two SAR-optical benchmarks covering scene classification and semantic segmentation, CroCoMAE improves over uni-modal SSL baselines and outperforms state-of-the-art cross-modal frameworks in most configurations, with gains in both single-modality and multi-modal evaluation across varying label regimes and the largest improvements on semantic segmentation.
items.title_ko: SAR-광학 원격 탐사 데이터용 교차 모달 자체 지도 공동 표현 학습 CroCoMAE
items.summary_ko: 원격 탐사는 SAR 및 광학 센서와 같은 보완적인 센서를 통해 지구 표면을 캡처하지만, 지상 진실 주석이 부족합니다. CroCoMAE는 교차 모달 자체 지도 학습(SSL)을 통해 이러한 문제에 접근하며, 기존 프레임워크가 놓치던 두 모달리티 간의 세분화된 상보성을 활용하여 특징을 정렬합니다.
items.why_ko: 원격 탐사 데이터 처리, 특히 SAR-광학 데이터 융합 분야의 개발자들에게 레이블 부족 문제를 해결하고 다양한 센서 정보를 효과적으로 활용할 수 있는 강력한 자체 지도 학습 프레임워크를 제공합니다.

items.title: Hx2Dx: From Anamnesis to Diagnosis - A Multimodal Arena for Conversational Clinical Reasoning in LLMs
items.body: Large language models (LLMs) achieve expert-level diagnostic accuracy in static evaluations, where the model receives a curated vignette or case report that already condenses the diagnostically relevant findings. Such evaluations measure inference over already selected evidence; the evaluations do not account for the inquiry used to obtain it. In clinical practice, however, diagnosis is an iterative process of inquiry. Clinicians take the patient's history, or anamnesis (Hx), through targeted questioning, examine the patient, and request and interpret tests, progressively narrowing the differential until they reach a final diagnosis (Dx). We introduce Hx2Dx ARENA, an interactive benchmark of 1'000 clinical cases from the New England Journal of Medicine (NEJM). Each case is a simulated encounter that proceeds from initial presentation through history taking and physical examination to diagnostic workup. We evaluate open- and closed-source LLMs under multiple configurations. Performance varies considerably across models in the interactive setting, and every model loses diagnostic accuracy relative to the static setting, where the full case is presented upfront. The ability to ask the right questions accounts for much of both the gap between models and the loss of accuracy: diagnosis improves as questions become more targeted and build a more complete clinical picture. LLMs thus reason well once the relevant data are available but remain limited in hypothesis-driven information gathering, in knowing what to ask in order to know. Closing this gap is a prerequisite for their safe integration into real-world diagnostic workflows.
